lede: The biggest item this week is Tuesday's Town Council meeting, where first reading of Land Use Code amendments tied to Colorado's wildfire resilience requirements puts real building rules on the table — something that hits close to home for anyone living in this box canyon. Council will also hold a second work session on the Telluride Energy Mitigation program the same night. Meanwhile, the Housing Authority meets Monday to seat its new Resident Advisory Committee, drawing from fifteen tenant applicants across Town properties, and the Open Space Commission walks the Valley Floor on Monday to scope out where a river trail in Reach 1 might actually go.
